extracted.subtask_description: A collection of Associated Press wartime news dispatches—battle reports, datelined field stories, political dispatches, and editor notes—intended for publication in newspapers. The page exemplifies newsroom copy and occasional editorial instructions to publishers (e.g., embargo/release notices).

rubrics_metrics.name: Advance/Release Notice (embargo) compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Editors should carry specified release notices and withhold further publication until the authorized release time. (From page: "MUTE TO EDITORS: THE DISPATCH CARRIED IN THE SUNDAY NIGHT REPORT... SHOULD HAVE CARRIED THIS RELEASE NOTICE: 'ADVANCE FOR USE AT P.M., EASTERN WAR TIME, TUESDAY, APRIL 27.' ... FURTHER PUBLICATION OF THIS DISPATCH UNTIL THE REL... THE ADMIRALTY IN LONDON REQUESTS THAT PAPERS MAKE NO ...")
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the official 'advance for use' notice when present; do not publish AP dispatches before the specified embargo/release time; comply with requests from authorities (e.g., Admiralty) to withhold or delay publication. Failure to respect embargoes or omission of the release notice is treated as an editorial error. Example wording on this page: 'Advance for use at p.m., Eastern War Time, Tuesday, April 27.'
